Avatar

A small square mark for a person or an agent, holding initials, an icon or an image, with the name beside it.

Status: draft

Examples

When to use it

  • To say who did something or who something belongs to: the author of a message, the actor of an event, the owner of a task.
  • With an icon for an agent and initials or an image for a person, so the two are told apart by shape as well as by name.
  • With the small size in a dense row, a timeline entry or a line of text.

When not to use it

  • As decoration, or in a stack of overlapping marks. Write the names, or a count such as 4 reviewers.
  • Without a name, unless the name is already written directly beside it. Then give the mark an accessible name.
  • For a repository, a branch or a file. Use text, with an icon in a list row where it helps.
  • For a status. Use a badge. The mark carries no tone and no status dot.

Variants

initials
The default. One or two capital letters in a span with the class gw-avatar__mark.
icon
An svg with the class gw-avatar__icon inside the mark, for an agent or a system actor.
image
An img with the class gw-avatar__mark in place of the span. It needs an alt attribute, width and height. The picture is cropped to the square.

Sizes

default
A 32px mark with the name in medium weight.
small gw-avatar--small
A 24px mark with the name at normal weight, for dense rows and lines of text.

Accessibility

  • Use a span with the class gw-avatar holding the mark and then the name in a span with the class gw-avatar__name. The name is visible by default and is what a screen reader reads.
  • Beside a visible name the mark is decoration: give a span mark aria-hidden="true", and an image mark alt="". The alt attribute is always present on an img.
  • With no visible name, the mark must carry the name: role="img" and aria-label on a span mark, or the name as the alt text of an image mark.
  • Say what kind of actor it is in words when it matters, such as Claude Code, implementer. The icon alone does not say it.
  • If an image fails to load, replace the img with the initials span. The stylesheet cannot do this.
  • An avatar is not focusable and takes no press. To link to a profile, put the whole avatar inside a link.
  • The avatar needs no script.

Classes

  • gw-avatar--small
